title: 第263章 天理循环第262章 小参
slug: 西游刚准备尸解成仙猴子来找
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：西游：刚准备尸解成仙，猴子来找第一卷：默认第263章天理循环（..la）平素只知在荒山野岭胡乱吞吐些日月精华，全不晓得修行正法，故而险些遭了那起炼气士的毒手。
如今既撞入这真仙道场，明日他讲课，定会讲些厉害的法门。若能从中摸索出个门道来，日后便也算有了安身立命的本钱也！
想罢，她仰起小脸，冲着杨明深深作了个揖，言道：“多谢大哥哥收留指点。我自幼无名无姓，因生在深山，阿爹便唤我作小参。大哥哥日后唤我小参便是。”
杨明听了，哈哈笑道：“小参？这名字倒也顺口，听着便是个实诚的。你且在此安心歇息，莫要乱跑。明日辰时，听得前头动静，自去听讲便了。”
说罢，收拾了碗筷，转身出房去了。
单表这小参，在房中安歇了一宿。次日清晨，天光初透，只听得前山石台方向，传来“笃、笃”几声木杖敲击之音，清脆入耳。
小参一骨碌爬起身来，胡乱理了理头上的冲天鬏，迈开小短腿，径顺着山道往前头跑去。
到了那石台左近，那五百弟子已然齐齐整整坐定。小参不敢造次，只在最后头寻了个不起眼的角落，挨着个石墩子坐下，支起耳朵细听。
谁知陶潜坐在台上，将手中一根木拐棍横在膝前，开口讲的却非甚么修行之术。
他口中念诵的，尽是些“道可道，非常道”、“无为而治”的黄老之学，又掺杂着些治国安邦的大道。
小参本是个深山里长大的草木精怪，虽化了个娇小憨态的女娃模样，到底不通教化，哪里懂得这等人间的深奥学问？听在耳中，直如蚊蝇嗡嗡，满脑子混沌。
听了半晌，小参只觉眼皮如坠了千斤重担，上下打架，小脑袋一点一点，竟是坐在那角落里打起瞌睡来。正睡得迷糊，忽觉额头上结结实实吃了一记。
“哎哟！”小参吃痛，猛地惊醒，捂着脑袋抬眼看去。不知何时，陶潜已走到她跟前，手中那根木拐棍正收将回去。
“听讲之时，不可贪睡。”陶潜将拐棍点着青石地面，转身缓缓踱回台前，重又坐下，继续开讲。
此番讲的，却是个好坏之理。陶潜目光扫过台下五百弟子，朗声道：“世人多论善恶好坏。贫道且问，人饥而猎兽，食其肉，寝其皮，可谓之坏乎？不可也。猛兽腹饥，捕人而食之，可谓之坏乎？亦不可也。此两者，皆顺应天道循环，物竞天择，本是天地之理。”
台下弟子皆静心聆听，小参也揉着额头，瞪大了乌溜溜的眼睛，不敢再睡。
陶潜接着道：“然则，若有人或兽，不为果腹，亦非为报仇雪恨，单只为了一己取乐，便去肆意打杀生灵，此等行径，便会生出业障。盖因这天道循环之中，本不含此等无端杀戮。此乃被私欲所累，纵情妄为，迟早要遭天谴也。”
小参听了这话，似懂非懂，只把那小脑袋点了一点，暗自将这番言语记在心头。
陶潜将那好坏之理讲得透彻，便把手中那根木拐棍在青石上顿了两顿，口中道：“今日便讲到此处，尔等各自揣摩去罢。”
言毕，站起身来，木拐棍点着地，笃笃笃地顺着原路回后山去了，再不回头。

台下那五百弟子，听了这半日课，哪个不是如获至宝？这战国乱世之中，学得一星半点治国安邦的手段，日后到了列国诸侯跟前，说不得就能博个客卿之位，封妻荫子。
故而陶潜一走，众人也不散去，三五成群聚在一处，有的在地上画着列国山川，有的口中念念有词复习方才的言语，恨不能将每一个字都嚼碎了咽下肚去。
单表那角落里，却有一个异类。
那五百人皆在苦读，唯独小参这女娃娃，蹲在台阶下的一窠黄土旁，正挽着袖子，两只小手和着些泥水，在那里捏泥巴耍子。
这女娃儿头上扎着两个冲天鬏，脸上东一道西一道的泥污还没洗净，如今又添了新泥。她一双乌黑眼珠滴溜溜转着，小手捏出个泥人，又捏出个泥狗，玩得不亦乐乎，模样着实娇憨可爱。
你道她为何这般惫懒？原来这小参本是个千年人参化形的精怪。她修行全凭吞吐日月精华，如今大白天里，未到时辰，采不得月华，收不来日精。
她又不是那等凡夫俗子，须得学些纵横阴阳、黄老刑名之术，去那齐楚燕韩赵魏秦七国之中寻个贵族当客卿。她一个深山里长大的草木精怪，要那些个人间的功名利禄则甚？
故而这半日的课，她听得如同嚼蜡，满脑子混沌。如今下了课，别人都在温习，她无事可做，自然只能蹲在这角落里，百无聊赖地玩起泥巴来。
正玩得兴起，忽听得身后有人发笑。小参扭头一看，却是杨明扛着笤帚走将过来。杨明见她弄得两手是泥，脸上也成了个大花猫，不由得笑道：
“你这小娃儿，先生讲的大道你不去记，倒在这里和泥玩。若是教先生撞见，少不得又要吃一记拐棍。”
小参撇了撇小嘴，把手里那个泥狗往地上一放，仰起脸道：“大哥哥，那些个学问，我听不懂，也用不着。如今这大白天的，不玩泥巴，还能作甚？”
杨明听了，也不去强求，只把笤帚顿在地上，道：“也罢，你既用不着这些，便随你耍子。只是莫要弄脏了先生的石台，不然我又要费力去扫。”
小参连连点头，两只小手在衣襟上蹭了蹭，又蹲下身去，专心致志地捏起一个泥老虎来。
小参蹲在那窠黄土旁，两只小手沾满了泥，正捏得起劲。
她先前捏了个泥人，巴掌大小，圆头圆脑的，又给它添了两条短腿、两只胳膊，末了拿指甲在那泥脸上划出两只眼、一张嘴来，歪歪扭扭的，倒也有几分意思。
捏完了便搁在地上晾着，自家又去和泥，预备再捏一个。
谁知那泥人方搁下不过片刻工夫，忽地自家动了一动。..la

Recommended reading for all book friends: Journey to the West: Just about to dissect the corpse and become an immortal, the monkey comes to find the first volume: Default Chapter 263: The Cycle of Heaven (..la) I usually only know how to swallow some essence of the sun and the moon in the barren mountains and mountains, but I don’t know how to practice the righteousness, so I almost suffered the poisonous hands of the Qi Refiner.
Now that he has crashed into this true immortal dojo, he will definitely teach some powerful methods in his lecture tomorrow. If you can find a way out of it, you will have the capital to settle down in the future!
After thinking about it, she raised her little face, bowed deeply to Yang Ming, and said, "Thank you, big brother, for taking me in and giving me guidance. I have been nameless since I was a child. Because I was born in a deep mountain, my father called me Xiao Shen. Big brother will call me Xiao Shen in the future."
After Yang Ming heard this, he laughed and said: "Xiao Shen? This name is quite easy to pronounce, and it sounds like a sincere person. Just rest here and don't run around. If you hear the sound in front of you tomorrow morning, just go and listen to the lecture."
After that, he put away the dishes and turned around and left the room.
This little ginseng rested in the room all night. In the early morning of the next day, when the sky first came through, I could hear the sound of "Duk, Duk" being struck by a wooden stick from the direction of the stone platform on the front mountain, which was crisp and clear to my ears.
Xiao Shen stood up in a hurry, straightened the hair on her head, spread her short legs, and ran forward along the mountain road.
When they arrived near the stone platform, the five hundred disciples were already sitting down neatly. Xiao Shen didn't dare to make any mistakes, so she found an inconspicuous corner at the end, sat down next to a stone pillar, raised her ears and listened carefully.
Unexpectedly, Tao Qian was sitting on the stage, holding a wooden walking stick in front of his knees, and what he was talking about was not about spiritual practice.
What he recited in his mouth were all Huang Lao's teachings of "Tao can be Tao, but it is not Tao" and "governing by doing nothing", mixed with some great ways of governing the country and bringing peace to the country.
Xiao Shen was originally a plant spirit who grew up in the mountains. Although she took on the appearance of a petite and naive girl, she was not educated. How could she understand the profound knowledge of this world? When I heard it, it was like mosquitoes buzzing in my ears, and my mind was filled with confusion.
After listening for a long time, Xiao Shen felt as if a heavy weight had fallen on her eyelids. She was fighting up and down, and her little head bit by bit, and she actually sat in the corner and dozed off. I was in a daze when I suddenly felt a solid bite on my forehead.
"Ouch!" Xiao Shen woke up suddenly in pain, covered her head and looked up. At some point, Tao Qian had walked up to her and was about to put back the wooden walking stick in his hand.
"Don't sleep while listening to the lecture." Tao Qian lit his walking stick on the bluestone ground, turned around and walked slowly back to the stage, sat down again, and continued to lecture.
What I’m talking about this time is the principle of good and bad. Tao Qian glanced at the five hundred disciples in the audience and said loudly: "People in the world talk about good and evil. I would like to ask, if a hungry man hunts an animal, eats its meat, and sleeps on its skin, is it bad? No way. Is it bad if a hungry beast catches a person and eats it? It is also impossible. Both of these are in line with the cycle of heaven, and natural selection is the principle of heaven and earth."
The disciples in the audience listened attentively. Xiao Shen also rubbed his forehead, widened his dark eyes, and did not dare to sleep again.
Tao Qian continued: "However, if there are people or animals who do not want to feed themselves, nor do they seek revenge, but just for their own pleasure, they will kill living beings arbitrarily. Such behavior will create karma. This is because the cycle of heaven does not include such unprovoked killings. This is because they are burdened by selfish desires and indulge in reckless behavior, and sooner or later they will be punished by God."
After hearing this, Xiao Shen seemed to understand, but nodded her little head a little, and secretly remembered these words in her heart.
After Tao Qian explained the truth about good and bad thoroughly, he paused the wooden walking stick in his hand on the bluestone twice and said, "That's it for today. Let's try to figure it out."
After saying that, he stood up, tapped the wooden walking stick on the ground, and walked back to the back mountain along the original path, never looking back.
Among the five hundred disciples in the audience, after listening to this half-day class, which one did not feel like they had found a treasure? In the chaotic times of the Warring States Period, I learned a little bit about the means of governing the country and bringing peace to the country.When you get in front of the princes of other countries, you can get the position of guest minister even if you don't think so, and you can be granted the title of wife and son.
Therefore, as soon as Tao Qian left, everyone did not disperse. They gathered in small groups. Some drew pictures of mountains and rivers from various countries on the ground, and some muttered words to review what they had just said, wishing they could chew every word and swallow it.
In the corner of Shan Biao, there is an alien.
The five hundred people were all studying hard, but the girl Xiao Shen was squatting next to a pile of loess at the foot of the steps. She was playing with mud with her sleeves rolled up and some muddy water in her two little hands.
This girl has two hairpins on her head, and the mud here and there on her face has not been washed away, and now there is new mud on her face. Her black eyes rolled around, and she made a clay figurine and then a clay dog ​​with her little hands. She had a great time playing with them, and she looked really cute and cute.
Do you know why she is so lazy? It turns out that this little ginseng is actually a spirit that took the form of a thousand-year-old ginseng. Her cultivation relies entirely on swallowing the essence of the sun and the moon. Now in broad daylight, before the time has come, she cannot collect the essence of the moon or the essence of the sun.
She is not that kind of ordinary person. She has to learn some skills of arranging Yin and Yang, Huang Lao and Xing Ming, and go to the seven kingdoms of Qi, Chu, Yan, Han, Zhao, Wei, and Qin to find a nobleman to be a guest. How much does she, a grassy spirit who grew up in the mountains, want personal fame and wealth?
Therefore, during this half-day class, she listened like chewing wax, and her mind was filled with confusion. Now that class was over and everyone else was reviewing, she had nothing to do, so naturally she could only squat in this corner and play with mud out of boredom.
When I was having fun, I suddenly heard someone laughing behind me. Xiao Shen turned around and saw Yang Ming walking over carrying a broom. Yang Ming saw that her hands were covered in mud and her face turned into a big cat, and he couldn't help but smile:
"You little kid, you don't remember what the teacher taught you, and you're just playing with the mud here. If the teacher bumps into you, you'll definitely get another slap from the cane."
Xiao Shen pouted her little mouth, put the mud dog in her hand on the ground, raised her face and said, "Brother, I don't understand those knowledge, and I don't have any use for it. What else can I do in broad daylight if I don't play with mud?"
After hearing this, Yang Ming didn't force it. He just put the broom on the ground and said, "That's fine. Since you don't need these, you can do whatever you want. Just don't make your master's stone platform dirty, otherwise I will have to clean it again."
Xiao Shen nodded repeatedly, rubbed his two small hands on the skirt of his clothes, squatted down again, and concentrated on holding up a clay tiger.
Xiao Ginseng squatted next to the loess, his two little hands were covered with mud, and he was squeezing hard.
She had previously made a clay figurine, about the size of a palm, with a round head and round head, and then added two short legs and two arms to it. Finally, she used her nails to carve out two eyes and a mouth on the clay face, which was crooked and somewhat interesting.
After kneading it, he put it on the ground to dry. He went to knead the mud again and prepared to knead another one.
Unexpectedly, the clay figurine only rested for a moment when it suddenly moved. ..la
